home.chooseWhoBody: A caregiver needs to pick the person, or people, who will play on this phone.
home.streakStart: Play today to start a streak

objectHunt.name: Object Hunt
objectHunt.instruction: Remember where each picture is hidden. Tap a tile to look.

wordStream.name: Market List
wordStream.instruction: Remember these things. We will ask you later.
wordStream.whichItems: Which items did we show you?

quickTap.name: Quick Tap
quickTap.instruction: Tap the picture as soon as you see it.

pathMatch.name: Path Match
pathMatch.instruction: Join the numbers in order, from 1 onwards.

memoryMatch.name: Memory Match
memoryMatch.instruction: Tap two cards. If they match, they stay open.

game.sessionComplete: Well done! You finished today's session.

sessionEnd.star3: Great job today! Keep it up!
sessionEnd.star1: Well done for trying! Each day gets better.
